title: Glean benchlet tally — compact probe ledger
content:
Summary: fast personal log for small-batch KV-cache / quantization probes. Use as scratch sheet for quick iteration and to capture outliers. Not cleaned for prod.

Columns:
run_id | date | model | seq_len | batch | quant | tokens/sent | p50_ms | p95_ms | cost_per_1k | kv_hit% | notes

Rows:
G-001 | 2026-03-02 | llama2-13b-8q | 128 | 8 | 8-bit | 512 | 28 | 84 | $0.31 | 18% | warm-kv=0, single-host
G-002 | 2026-03-04 | llama2-13b-8q | 512 | 4 | 8-bit | 2048 | 46 | 132 | $0.44 | 45% | prefix-cache on, steady-state
G-003 | 2026-03-06 | mixtral-8x | 256 | 6 | 4-bit | 1024 | 22 | 68 | $0.19 | 10% | lower mem, quant artifacts at high temp
G-004 | 2026-03-08 | mt-70b | 128 | 2 | fp16 | 256 | 180 | 420 | $1.12 | 0% | baseline for larger model
G-005 | 2026-03-09 | llama2-13b-8q | 128 | 16 | 8-bit | 1024 | 36 | 98 | $0.27 | 32% | batch increased -> p50 up slightly, cost down

Quick calculations (personal formulas):
cost_per_1k = (gpu_unit_cost_per_hour / (tokens_per_sec * 3600)) * 1000  -- useful for quick sanity checks

Notes to self: 
- G-002 looks like best latency/cost tradeoff for medium context where kv hit >30%.
- Watch for quant flakiness with mixtral at temp >=0.8. Add a short eval (5 prompts) next run.
- Try pinned KV shards on G-006 to see warm-up improvement.

TODOs (short):
- [ ] Add 5-shot eval set and record accuracy/fluency scores alongside latency (small rubric).
- [ ] Re-run G-003 at temp 0.2 and 0.0 to isolate hallucination trend.
- [ ] Capture memory RSS and device swap for runs >12 batch.

Scratch observations: 
- On bursts when host switches, p95 spikes correlate with cache eviction (~2-3x). Need to flag these runs in prod rollouts.
- Slack thread #bench-wars has a note about batching jitter; link during next sync.

Reference IDs: quick notes attached below for traceability: PR#842 bench harness adds stable seeding, ENG-2198 is the ticket for KV-cache improvements.

End of sheet (quick, untidy).
